Hair thinning and balding (alopecia) `stem from genetics, hormonal shifts, stress, or medical conditions` , and can be managed with targeted treatments like minoxidil or finasteride.[[1]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/symptoms-causes/syc-20372926)[[2]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/its-not-too-late-to-save-thinning-hair)

### Common Causes of Hair Thinning

- **Androgenetic Alopecia:** Hereditary male- or female-pattern baldness causing gradual follicle shrinking.
- **Telogen Effluvium:** Temporary, widespread shedding triggered by physical or emotional stress, illness, or rapid weight loss.
- **Alopecia Areata:** An autoimmune condition that causes smooth, circular bald patches.
- **Lifestyle & Styling:** Traction alopecia from tight braids or ponytails, or damage from harsh heat and chemical treatments.[[1]](https://nyulangone.org/conditions/hair-loss/types)[[2]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/its-not-too-late-to-save-thinning-hair)[[3]](https://www.nhsinform.scot/illnesses-and-conditions/a-to-z/alopecia/)[[4]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/symptoms-causes/syc-20372926)[[5]](https://www.isdin.com/us/blog/beauty/hair-and-nails/what-causes-hair-loss-top-7-reasons/)[[6]](https://www.webmd.com/beauty/thinning-hair)

### Proven Treatments & Approaches

- **Topical or Oral Medications:** Treatments like **minoxidil** (topical or oral) and **finasteride** or **dutasteride** (for men) help enlarge follicles and slow loss.[[1]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/its-not-too-late-to-save-thinning-hair)
- **Specialized Care Products:** Over-the-counter thickening regimens like [Nioxin Scalp + Hair Thickening System 3 Kit](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462502917497423,imageDocid:17405168000393903935,gpcid:15001577465414552463,headlineOfferDocid:9877927087563424927,catalogid:3057342393943112449,productDocid:995778851087746724,rds:PC_15001577465414552463%7CPROD_PC_15001577465414552463&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj0_sON4cKXAxXhUUEAHb90BXEQxa4PegYIAggZEAs) or [The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum for Hair Density](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462374527879519,imageDocid:16793207472069530819,gpcid:6338084888880786793,headlineOfferDocid:7916282864560586557,catalogid:1254766242216501565,productDocid:4226417424048811923,rds:PC_6338084888880786793%7CPROD_PC_6338084888880786793&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj0_sON4cKXAxXhUUEAHb90BXEQxa4PegYIAggZEA0) can support a healthier scalp environment.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:995778851087746724,catalogid:3057342393943112449,gpcid:15001577465414552463,mid:576462502917497423&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4226417424048811923,catalogid:1254766242216501565,gpcid:6338084888880786793,mid:576462374527879519&ibp=oshop)
- **Medical Interventions:** Dermatologist-led options include steroid injections for alopecia areata, low-level laser therapy, or hair transplant surgery.[[1]](https://www.nhs.uk/symptoms/hair-loss/)[[2]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/its-not-too-late-to-save-thinning-hair)

You can learn more about symptoms and evaluation via the [Mayo Clinic Hair Loss Guide](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/symptoms-causes/syc-20372926) or review medical options on [Harvard Health Publishing](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/its-not-too-late-to-save-thinning-hair).[[1]](https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/hair-loss/symptoms-causes/syc-20372926)[[2]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/skin-and-hair-health/its-not-too-late-to-save-thinning-hair)To help narrow down what might be going on, tell me:

- What **pattern or area** of the head is affected?
- How **long** have you noticed the thinning or shedding?
